objective: Decompose post-setup candidate scarcity into TARGET_NULL, LOW_RR and FINAL_GRADE without changing Formal target/RR logic.

provenanceRules.targetPrice: Raw value can be captured, but current repository has no canonical producer/source/asOf/knownAt/PIT contract. Presence is not trusted provenance.
provenanceRules.sourceTie: Formal selects only a price, not a source. If multiple source candidates share the selected minimum price, receipt MUST preserve selectedTargetSources[] and MUST NOT invent one source.
provenanceRules.history: Use same-scan in-memory feature.history only. Do not reconstruct rejected geometry later from mutable current history.
provenanceRules.pivots: Preserve pivot date+price for every detected candidate.

scarcityStates.TARGET_NULL: No eligible resistance strictly above entry*1.01. RR undefined/UNKNOWN.
scarcityStates.LOW_RR: Target exists and positive risk geometry is valid, but RR<2.
scarcityStates.TARGET_RR_GRADE_PASS: Target/RR/grade pass only; not Formal-qualified unless all upstream Formal gates are proven passed.
scarcityStates.RR_PASSED_GRADE_UNKNOWN: RR passes but setupQuality evidence missing.
scarcityStates.RISK_NONPOSITIVE_OR_INVALID: Risk denominator invalid; do not invent RR.

legacyShadowHas: some score/RR provenance for Formal-ok rows
currentDurableSnapshotGap.implication: Historical legacy Shadow cannot cleanly decompose target-null vs low-RR provenance after the fact.

implementationBoundary.classA: Compute observer from already-loaded same-scan feature/history and derived entry/stop; zero new market calls; no Formal dependency.
implementationBoundary.classB: Persist immutable prospective receipts / targetPrice provenance / shared runtime wiring.
implementationBoundary.classC: Any change to target formula, 1% band, source priority, RR threshold or grade threshold.

falsificationBeforeOptimization: Measure independent-date incidence with complete parent denominators.
Separate target-null source-quality/provenance failure from genuine blue-sky/no-overhead geometry.
Test B new-high concentration in TARGET_NULL.
Test source-specific target behavior and 1% band false-conservative/false-optimistic cases.
Only after mature prospective outcomes compare D1/D3/D5/D10/D20, MFE/MAE, stop/false-break, costs, zero-pick, coverage and OOS.
